summary: Registers and documents the MIME types associated with the 3GPP2 multimedia file format, which belongs to the family based on the ISO Media File Format. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: Labels that tell computers what kind of phone-video file they are looking at.

questions: what file extension do 3gpp2 files use
subtitle: Registers audio/3gpp2 and video/3gpp2 so 3G2 phone media files can be labeled correctly over HTTP and in multipart documents.

tldr.problem: The 3GPP2 file format for audio and video on cellular phones had no registered MIME types, so servers could not label such files correctly.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC registers two types, audio/3gpp2 for files with audio but no visual material and video/3gpp2 for any file, with the usual suffix .3g2.
tldr.outcome: It is a Proposed Standard that has since been updated by RFC 6381.

today: RFC 4393 is a Proposed Standard that has been updated by RFC 6381. Check that RFC for the changes to the registrations.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
The third-generation partnership project 2 (3GPP2) defined a standard file format, called 3G2, for audio and visual sequences that can be downloaded to cellular phones. At the time of writing, it can hold H.263, H.264 or MPEG-4 video; 13K Vocoder, EVRC or AMR Narrow-band speech, or AAC audio; and 3GPP timed text.

Like all files in the ISO family, a 3G2 file has a file-type box that lists four-letter brands. Files labeled with the types in this RFC MUST list, in their compatible brands, a brand defined in a 3GPP2 standard. The MIME types are needed to identify such files when served over HTTP, included in multi-part documents or used elsewhere MIME types appear.
sections.eli5: A phone video file has a tag inside saying what it is. The new labels outside the file let computers know what it is without opening it.

sections.title: The Two Registered Types
sections.content:
The registration covers all files in the 3G2 format identified with a suitable brand in a 3GPP2 specification. The usual suffix is .3g2; the registrations also declare 3gpp2, with 3g2 preferred. The Macintosh file type code is '3gp2'.

audio/3gpp2 may be used for files containing audio but no visual presentation. Such files MUST NOT contain any visual material, and the RFC notes that 3GPP timed text counts as visual. video/3gpp2 is valid for all files, and it is valid to serve an audio-only file as video/3gpp2.

Both types have no required parameters and one optional parameter, Codecs, defined in RFC 4281. If the body contains another container format, Codecs MUST list all codecs of all formats, including contained ones. Both list the 3GPP2 specifications C.S0045 and C.S0050 as published specifications, and 3GPP2 is the change controller.
sections.eli5: There are two labels. One says 'sound only', and the other says 'might have pictures'. The picture label also works for sound-only files.

sections.title: Encoding and Identification
sections.content:
The data is binary. It should be transmitted in a suitable encoding without CR/LF conversion or 7-bit stripping; base64 is a suitable encoding. These types are for files only. Real-time transfer uses separate types, such as the RTP payload formats for 13K vocoder speech (RFC 2658) and, for video, H.263 (RFC 2429).

There is no magic number as such. However, the file-type box must occur first in the file and MUST contain a 3GPP2 brand in its compatible brands list.
sections.eli5: These files are not plain text, so they must be sent without anyone fiddling with the bytes. The first thing inside the file says what kind it is.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content:
The format can hold audio, video and displayable text, and has no provision for active elements such as scripts. Files could still be crafted to demand an excessively large picture size or high sampling-rate audio, though clients can and usually do protect themselves.

Some metadata fields may carry information meant to protect media against unauthorized use, and altering or removing it is intended to be treated as an offense under WIPO treaties. The format is extensible, so future fields could in theory induce actions in the recipient, but the referenced specification does not support that. Encryption, signing or authentication can be done with any media-independent transformation.
sections.eli5: The files only hold sound, pictures and text, not programs. A bad file might be oversized to cause trouble, but players are usually careful.

sections.title: Interoperability and Conformance
sections.content: Both registrations say that 3GPP2 defined the specification of the media format. Interoperability and conformance testing is done in cooperation with other bodies, including the Open Mobile Alliance (OMA) and the International Multimedia Telecommunications Consortium (IMTC). The intended usage is COMMON and the application area is listed as multi-media.
sections.eli5: Several groups work together to check that phones and players all understand these files the same way.

sections.title: IANA Considerations
sections.content: The only IANA action is to register the two MIME media types audio/3gpp2 and video/3gpp2, as defined in the document. The RFC used RFC 3839 as a template for the registrations.
sections.eli5: The official list of labels gets two new entries, and that is all this RFC asks for.
